# UPWRD Studio

> UPWRD Studio is a founder-led web design studio in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, building websites since 2025. It designs and builds fast, mobile-first websites and online stores, plus on-brand social media and marketing design, for small businesses — cafés, restaurants, salons and spas, professional firms and local shops. It works in English, Bahasa Malaysia, Mandarin and Cantonese, serving Kuala Lumpur, Selangor and businesses across Malaysia.

Clients work directly with the founder who designs and builds their website. Every project has a fixed quote agreed before work starts (50% upfront, 50% on completion), includes three rounds of revisions, and the client owns their website and domain once paid. Most business websites are built on WordPress so clients can edit them; landing pages and showcase sites are custom-coded.

## Pricing (MYR)

- Landing Page: RM 1,500 — single-page, mobile-first site with WhatsApp and enquiry buttons, Google Maps, basic SEO and copywriting (about 1 week)
- Business Website: from RM 3,800 — up to 8 pages, SEO setup, Google Business Profile link, easy to update (3–4 weeks)
- Online store (e-commerce): from RM 6,500 — with FPX and card payments (6–8 weeks)
- Social Media Design: RM 800 per month for 8 posts; single designs from RM 150
- Care Plan: RM 150 per month (hosting, SSL, backups, updates, small edits); Care Plus RM 300 per month
- Digital Foundation bundle: RM 5,200 — Business Website + 3 months of social media design (8 posts per month)
